LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestLetter.InfoText: The Adventurers' Guild was founded by the first Archotech to descend, and it handles the forwarding and issuing of commissions.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RefugeeResettleFai: All the refugees have died. The Rank-Up Quest has failed.
No refugee boarded the shuttle or joined the colony. The Rank-Up Quest has failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CommissionRevokedC: The Guild has discovered that the resettlement subjects were imprisoned or enslaved. The commission is revoked immediately, and the remaining refugees will leave the colony on their own.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CommissionRevokedS: The Guild has discovered that the resettlement subjects were subjected to harmful surgery again. The commission is revoked immediately, and the refugees will leave the colony on their own.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RefugeeRaidLetterT: The Dark Faction hunting the refugees has found your colony, and they will not let the matter rest.\n\n{BASETEXT}
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RefugeeJoined: {0} has decided to stay in the colony and has joined the Familia.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RefugeeSurgeryWarn: The Guild has discovered that {0} was subjected to harmful surgery.\n\nThis is the final warning. If it happens again, the commission will be revoked immediately.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CriminalSpottedTex: {0} is the wanted criminal you are hunting, hiding among the outpost guards.\n\nKill them to complete the commission. If you capture them, bring them back to your settlement and put them on the Guild's extradition shuttle to earn double the reward.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CriminalKilledInOu: The wanted criminal has been killed. Commission complete.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CriminalSubduedTex:
The threat at the outpost has been cleared, and the wanted criminal is still alive and subdued.

Take them along with your caravan, leave the camp and bring them back to your settlement. Within 1-3 days of leaving the camp, the Guild's extradition shuttle will rendezvous at your settlement.

If the criminal dies, the commission is settled as complete. If they are recruited or enslaved, or go missing, the commission will fail.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CriminalDiedText: The wanted criminal has died. The Guild settles the commission as a completed hunt.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CriminalClaimedTex: The wanted criminal was recruited or enslaved. Commission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.CriminalMissingTex: The wanted criminal has escaped and their whereabouts are unknown. Commission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.ExtraditionComplet: The Guild's extradition shuttle has left your settlement with the wanted criminal aboard.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.ExtraditionFailedT: The extradition shuttle has departed, and the wanted criminal was not aboard. Commission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.SupplyEscortTimeou: The 12-day time limit for the commission "{0}" has expired, and the supplies were not delivered to {1} in time.\n\nCommission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.SupplyEscortOverwe: The supplies weigh about {0}kg in total. Once taken, the caravan will be overloaded by about {1}kg and may be unable to move.\n\nAre you sure you want to force it in anyway?
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.SupplyEscortPicked:
You have received the supplies from {0} (about {1}kg in total):

{2}

Deliver these supplies unchanged to {3} within 12 days. Delivery is checked item by item against the manifest, and both type and quantity must match. Partial deliveries are accepted; items not on the manifest will not be taken.

Note: you may be ambushed along the way.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.SupplyEscortDelive: The supplies have been delivered to {0} in full.\n\nThe Guild acknowledges the Familia's performance.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.SupplyEscortNothin: (The caravan is not carrying any supplies on the delivery manifest)
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.AncientRelicFoundT:
You have found the target item the Guild asked for: {0}.

Bring it back to your settlement and load it onto the Guild's shuttle to complete the commission.

If the target item is destroyed or taken, the commission will fail.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.AncientRelicDestro: The target item has been destroyed. Commission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.AncientRelicMissin: The target item has been destroyed or has gone missing. Commission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.AncientRelicLostTe: The target item has gone missing (taken or lost). Commission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RelicDeliveryFaile: The target item was not delivered in time and the shuttle has departed. Commission failed.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.AncientRelicShuttl: The Guild's shuttle has departed with the target item.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RescueSearchComple: The threat has been cleared, and the wounded will follow your orders.\nThe shuttle of their original faction will arrive in a few hours.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RescueCompleteText: The shuttle has taken {0}/{1} wounded aboard.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RescueFailedAllDea: All the wounded died before they could be rescued.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestPart.RescueFailedShuttl: The shuttle could not take all the wounded aboard and has departed ahead of time.\nThe victims left behind will leave on their own.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.SupplyEscortPickup: Receive the Guild's supplies from {0}.\n\nOnce received, deliver them unchanged, exactly as listed, to the delivery point specified by the commission.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.SupplyEscortNotRea: Supplies have not yet been received from the pickup point
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.EnvoyArrivalLetter: An envoy of the Adventurers' Guild, {0}, has arrived at your settlement.\n\nSend a colonist to speak with the envoy and learn the details of the commission.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.RankUpPromotionLet: The Guild has raised your Familia's rank in "{0}" to "{1}"!
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.RefugeeResettleArr:
The refugees have arrived at the edge of the colony.

They will stay in the colony for 15 days, after which a Guild shuttle will pick them up.
Protect them from Dark Faction attacks.

{BASETEXT}
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.RefugeeJoinOfferDe: {0} is willing to stay and live in the colony.\n\nAccept them as a full member?
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.RankUpQuestLearnMo:
For a Familia that has distinguished itself in a certain field, the Guild issues a Rank-Up Quest, demanding the contribution that is owed.
This quest cannot be refused. If it times out or fails, it will be reissued after some time.

Note that this quest is highly dangerous, so send as much of your fighting strength as you can.
Completing it will raise your Familia's rank in "{0}".
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.CannotTalkNoSpeech: Cannot talk: no capacity for speech
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.QuestMisc.EnvoyLetterFallbac: The envoy explains the details of the commission to you.
